Anyone with any MtG experience could mix cards and make a truely sick deck, but then your win % would go to like 99%. Basically the game is desinged so that some cards are less optimal for thematic and balance reasons.   

COULD is the key word here.  It is possible to deck build for a deck you personally enjoy the feel of rather than strictly trying to make it as powerful as possible.

 

For example, perhaps I think Pride and Predjudice are super fun so I replace every gun in Expat's deck with Quick Draw.  Now Arsenal access pretty much only gets ammo and flack jackets.  Unload is still usable if I play the DW Expat.  Overall I might find it more fun to play but I think there is a pretty strong case that I haven't made the deck significantly stronger.
